Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL3070. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Require target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', tax_id = 9606, standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value not null. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to include canonical SMILES. Keep all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID and assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to the first 1000 rows.
